title: Evaluation after removing repeated inputs
statement: Let a Boolean gate be an AND gate, an OR gate, or a NOT gate, with a finite list of natural-number input indices, and let the available values be a finite list of Booleans (an out-of-range index is read as false). Removing repeated indices from the gate’s input list leaves its evaluation unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean gate with a finite list of natural-number input indices
A finite list of Boolean values
